description: Record and replay every agent action — tool calls, arguments, state changes, cost, latency, failures — with a scrubbable timeline.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: Agent observability is a real need and the replay-share loop is a genuinely viral mechanic for debugging threads. Weakest assumption: LangSmith, Helicone, and Arize already own this category with distribution; this is a feature in their roadmap, not a company. Would a team send this to a coworker? They'd send a Blackbox link, which is the best thing this idea has going for it.
Blackbox replay + jump-to-failure scrub steps; timeline advances; zero errors.

notes.change: Opens on the failed step; added Copy-debug-link deep links (#step=N) so a run can be shared at the exact failure.
